name: next-steps-plugin
description: Session-prediction plugin for Hermes Desktop — local Ollama, per-session state, target routing (session/bot/kanban), tiny-model support, EN/DE.

scripts.test: node tests/run_test_v11.mjs && node tests/run_test_v10.mjs && node tests/run_test_v9.mjs && node tests/run_test_v9b.mjs && node tests/run_test_v7.mjs
scripts.test:full: node tests/run_test_v11.mjs && node tests/run_test_v10.mjs && node tests/run_test_v6.mjs && node tests/run_test_v7.mjs && node tests/run_test_v9.mjs && node tests/run_test_v9b.mjs
scripts.deploy: mkdir -p ~/.hermes/desktop-plugins/next-steps && cp plugin.js ~/.hermes/desktop-plugins/next-steps/plugin.js && echo 'Deployed. Restart Hermes Desktop or ⌘K → Reload desktop plugins.'
